summary: This document describes how a node can report its locally known Segment Routing (SR) Policy information using BGP Link State (BGP-LS). External components can use it for path computation, reoptimization, service placement, and network visualization.

eli5.summary: Routers keep private notes about the special routes they use. This gives them a standard way to share the notes with a central planner who can see the whole map.
